svg.title: Figure 3 | Acceptance in AI collaboration
svg.desc: Arrows show how work and evidence pass between responsibilities. Actual evidence determines acceptance, correction or pending verification; the diagram is not an acceptance result.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Humans define requirements and acceptance criteria
Write completion conditions into the specification.
AI Agent implements code and tests
Follow the specification and cover existing behavior, abnormal inputs
Tools and people collect verification evidence
Retain version, environment, inputs, expected results and actual
Use evidence to accept, correct or retain Not Tested
Limit completion claims to what the evidence supports.
Arrows show how work and evidence pass between responsibilities. Actual
evidence determines acceptance, correction or pending verification; the
diagram is not an acceptance result.
